# CiteTail

> CiteTail helps businesses and website owners improve their visibility, discoverability, and citations across AI-powered search and answer engines through Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://citetail.com/)
- [AEO](https://citetail.com/aeo)
- [GEO](https://citetail.com/geo)

## What CiteTail Does

CiteTail focuses on optimizing websites and content for the evolving landscape of AI-powered search, answer engines, and generative AI systems.

Its primary areas of focus are:

- Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
- AI search visibility
- AI citations and brand mentions
- Content optimization for AI-generated answers
- Website discoverability across AI-powered search experiences

## Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)

AEO focuses on helping content become more useful, understandable, and eligible to be surfaced in direct answers generated by answer engines and AI-powered search systems.

CiteTail provides guidance and strategies for structuring website content so that important information can be clearly understood and referenced by AI systems.

## Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)

GEO focuses on improving a brand's visibility and representation within generative AI experiences.

CiteTail addresses strategies for increasing the likelihood that a business, website, product, or brand is discovered, understood, mentioned, and cited by generative AI systems.

## AI Visibility

CiteTail's approach to AI visibility focuses on making website information:

- Clear
- Structured
- Factual
- Contextually relevant
- Easy for AI systems to interpret
- Supported by authoritative information

## Important Concepts

AEO and GEO overlap but are not identical.

AEO primarily focuses on optimizing content for direct answers and answer-oriented search experiences.

GEO focuses more broadly on visibility, representation, mentions, and citations within generative AI experiences.

Both approaches can be used together as part of an overall AI search visibility strategy.
